pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ancient Tower Remains.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the End. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Arrow protection is enabled. Direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds is rejected as well. Native sleep blocks normal hits. Wait for its active state and retaliate with melee after a wind-up.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Anchor Handle. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
